name: agentpit
description: Claude Code plugins that keep a session's context, its prompt cache and a subscription's usage limits in view (PaceLine, PitBoard and PitCrew), run queued work while you are away (Stint), and give database access at three levels (dbWise).

plugins.name: paceline
plugins.description: Keeps a Claude Code subscription's usage limits in view: a per-hour budget against the five-hour and weekly limits, and exact usage readings.

plugins.name: pitboard
plugins.description: A status row for Claude Code in the CLI and in Desktop: context against the auto-compaction point, the prompt cache's time to live and hit rate, and the five-hour and weekly limits with their pace.

plugins.name: pitcrew
plugins.description: Keeps a Claude Code session's context and prompt cache in shape: warnings and snapshots around auto-compaction (context-watch), and a prompt cache kept alive while a session is idle (cache-watch).

plugins.name: stint
plugins.description: A queue of unattended work for Claude Code: runs queued items one at a time while you are away, bounded by PaceLine's advice or, without PaceLine, by its own stops at the weekly and five-hour limits.

plugins.name: dbwise
plugins.description: Gives Claude Code database access, starting with PostgreSQL, at three levels per alias: read (the default), diagnose and write. Each level can connect with its own credential, and passwords stay in the OS keychain.
